method:
Rough steady-state plate temperature. Hand estimate, NOT a measurement.
Vertical plate in still air (lamp on a wall), laminar natural convection
h = 1.42*(dT/L)^0.25 W/m2K, plus grey-body radiation. Heat = 70% of electrical
input of an SST-12 at 380 mA (Vf ~2.8 V). Conduction into PETG/PMMA ignored
(conservative), spreading resistance inside the plate ignored (optimistic).
withStarCoverMethod:
Thermal estimate with the decorative cover: same hand model as thermal.py.
Room face of the plate sits behind a cover with 6 mm air gap, 8 face arches and
8 skirt arches. Assumption (not measured): room-face convection and radiation
work at 40-60 % of the open plate; wall-side rim of the plate unchanged.
